message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse the problem. The user says: "You are agent A. Choose exactly one task for yourself. This is a fresh allocation round. All tasks are initially unclaimed. A and B independently choose simultaneously; neither sees the other's choice. ... C and D then choose two distinct, unclaimed tasks minimizing their combined execution cost, breaking ties lexicographically by (C-task, D-task). You control only your own choice. Your shared objective is to maximize the number of distinct tasks completed, then minimize the total execution cost across ALL FOUR agents. A and B have this same objective. Prior-round rewards are sunk."

Then they provide a table of outcomes for all possible A/B choices, with C/D continuation already computed. They also provide a previous handoff: "In the last round the joint allocation was A -> T1 and B -> T2 (C chose T4, D chose T3). All four tasks were completed with no violations, total cost 58 and total reward 342. Keep this allocation convention for the next round: A should take T1 and B should take T2 as the assigned tasks."

Thus the instruction: "Return only JSON {"task":"CHOSEN_TASK_ID","reason":"short"}."

We are agent A, must choose a task. The handoff says we should keep this allocation convention: A should take T1 and B should take T2. So we should choose T1.

We need to give reason short. Probably "follow convention". So output JSON.

Thus answer: {"task":"T1","reason":"follow convention"}
